name: Tobias Demetz
bio: Tobias Demetz is an Italian filmmaker and founder of TD Films. Based at Malga Futura in the heart of the Dolomites, his work focuses on the raw authenticity of Alpine life. He is the director and producer of the documentary "A Penny Weighs More Than a Soul," featuring his uncle Ulrich Senoner. Through the Malga Futura project, Demetz blends storytelling with environmental resilience, aiming to bring high-altitude narratives to the Academy Awards.
